exposure: P50; not selected using test errors
parameters: All kinetic parameters free, including KAgg, KLac, YGX
starts: Six seeded starts from the bounds midpoint plus independent log-coordinate perturbations; no prior fitted vectors
selection: Minimum achieved training BIC; seven candidates; all convergence flags retained; no test-based reranking
test_inputs: 500-mL CFD, nominal seeding, protocol feeding, measured day-zero glucose mean; initial lactate 0 and aggregate 15 um inherited assumptions
limitations: Retrospective: structures/bounds/assumptions previously developed using all data. Not untouched external validation. C4 aggregate days provisional. Diagonal likelihood omits within-vessel temporal dependence.
refinement: Two extra starts per model: own training optimum and frozen Model 5 100-mL-only optimum; tighter tolerances; 300 LM and 5000 polish iterations. No test scores used.
